post.description: Authenticates a user with email and password. Returns a JWT access token (15 min) and a refresh token (30 days). Rate limited to 5 requests per minute.

type.description: User-defined tax category (PF, ESI, PT, TDS, or any custom value)

isStatutory.description: Mark true for statutory deductions like PF, ESI, PT, TDS

config.description: Calculation config. PERCENTAGE: { rate, employeeSplit?, employerSplit? }. FIXED: { amount }. SLAB_BASED: { slabs: [{fromAmount, toAmount?, rate?, fixedAmount?}] }

applicabilityRules.description: Restrict applicability by employment type, designation level range, or salary ceiling

value.description: FIXED: monthly amount in org currency. PERCENTAGE: 0-100 percent of baseOn. VARIABLE: base rate/cap.

baseOn.description: For PERCENTAGE type — what the percentage is calculated against. Defaults to CTC.

isDeductible.description: true = deduction (PF, ESI); false = earning (Basic, HRA)

isStatutory.description: true = statutory component (auto-computed by payroll engine)

field.description: The field to evaluate in the condition

operator.description: Comparison operator. Use IN/NOT_IN for employmentType (value must be array).

value.description: Value to compare against. Array for IN/NOT_IN, scalar otherwise.

type.description:
Action type. Must match ruleType:
    ELIGIBILITY → ALLOW | DENY
    ENTITLEMENT → SET_DAYS | ADD_DAYS
    APPLICATION → SET_MIN_ADVANCE | SET_MAX_CONSECUTIVE | SET_MAX_PER_YEAR
    APPROVAL    → AUTO_APPROVE | MANAGER | HR | MULTI_LEVEL
    CARRY_FORWARD → SET_MAX_DAYS | SET_EXPIRY_MONTHS | ENCASH_REMAINDER

value.description: Numeric value (days, months, levels). Required for most non-DENY/AUTO_APPROVE actions.

levels.description: Number of approval levels for MULTI_LEVEL approvals

name.example: Extra day for 5+ years of service

ruleType.description: What aspect of the leave policy this rule governs

conditionLogic.description: Whether ALL conditions must be true (AND) or just one (OR)

conditions.description: Conditions that must be satisfied for this rule to fire

action.description: Action to execute when conditions are satisfied

priority.description: Execution order — lower number runs first
